_note: Tick pixel centres (full-resolution embedded JPEG, pixel row/col, origin top-left) located by tick-mark detection (probe: dark runs just outside the left/bottom axis lines), then recorded here by hand. digitize.py fits a linear pixel->data map by least squares to these ticks. Axes are linear in both directions as printed: x 'Angle [degrees]', y 'Log(PSF)'.
